title: Meal Planning on a Changing Schedule
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，回答8个问题。问题包括单选、填空和判断正误（True/False/Not Given）。填空答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。所有题目和选项均为英文，解释为中文。本材料为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思考试。
passage:
A. Lin is a busy nurse in Shanghai. Her work schedule changes every week. Some weeks she works early shifts, and some weeks she works late shifts. Because of this, Lin plans her meals carefully. She does not want to eat too much fast food. She knows she should eat more vegetables and fruit.

B. On Sunday evening, Lin sits down with her notebook. She writes a meal plan for the week. She checks how many days she works and how much time she has for cooking. She has a few recipes for quick meals. She also has a little time on Wednesday to go to the market. She should buy some eggs, tomatoes, and rice. She should not buy too many snacks because she eats them too quickly.

C. Lin also thinks about her drinks. She drinks a lot of water, but she drinks too much coffee on late shifts. She should drink less coffee and more water. She has a little milk in the fridge, so she can make a healthy breakfast. She has a few apples, too. On busy days, she takes an apple and some nuts to work. She does not have many breaks, so she eats quickly.

D. Lin's friend, Mei, asks her, "How much time do you have for lunch?" Lin says, "Only a little time, about twenty minutes." Mei says, "You should prepare your lunch the night before. Then you can eat well and not rush." Lin agrees. She starts to prepare simple lunches. She puts rice, vegetables, and chicken in a box. Now she eats better and feels good.

questions.evidence: Lin is a busy nurse in Shanghai.

questions.prompt: How often does Lin's work schedule change?
questions.explanation: 原文说“Her work schedule changes every week.”，所以她的工作时间表每周变化。
questions.evidence: Her work schedule changes every week.

questions.prompt: Lin writes a meal plan on ______ evening. (one word)

questions.evidence: On Sunday evening, Lin sits down with her notebook.

questions.prompt: What should Lin buy at the market?
questions.explanation: 原文说“She should buy some eggs, tomatoes, and rice.”，所以应该买鸡蛋、西红柿和米饭。
questions.evidence: She should buy some eggs, tomatoes, and rice.

questions.prompt: Why should Lin not buy too many snacks?
options: She has no time to eat them.

questions.evidence: She should not buy too many snacks because she eats them too quickly.

questions.prompt: What does Lin drink too much on late shifts?
questions.explanation: 原文说“she drinks too much coffee on late shifts.”，所以晚班时喝太多咖啡。
questions.evidence: she drinks too much coffee on late shifts.

questions.prompt: How much time does Lin have for lunch?
questions.explanation: 原文中Lin说“Only a little time, about twenty minutes.”，所以只有一点时间。
questions.evidence: Only a little time, about twenty minutes.

questions.explanation: 原文中Mei说“You should prepare your lunch the night before.”，所以这句话正确。

grammar.title: 数量表达：much / many / a little / a few；should / should not
grammar.explanation: 在英语中，much 用于不可数名词（如 water, time, coffee），many 用于可数名词复数（如 snacks, breaks, apples）。a little 表示“一点”，用于不可数名词；a few 表示“几个”，用于可数名词复数。should 表示“应该”，should not 表示“不应该”，后面都接动词原形。例如：She should eat more vegetables. She should not buy too many snacks.
grammar.example: She should buy some eggs, tomatoes, and rice.

questions.prompt: I have ______ time. I can help you.
questions.explanation: time 是不可数名词，表示“一点时间”用 a little。
questions.evidence: She has a little time on Wednesday to go to the market.

questions.prompt: There are ______ apples on the table.
questions.explanation: apples 是可数名词复数，表示“几个苹果”用 a few。
questions.evidence: She has a few apples, too.

questions.prompt: You ______ drink more water. It is good for you.
questions.explanation: 表示“应该”做某事，用 should + 动词原形。
questions.evidence: She should drink less coffee and more water.

questions.prompt: He ______ eat too much candy. It is not healthy.
questions.explanation: 表示“不应该”做某事，用 should not + 动词原形。
questions.evidence: She should not buy too many snacks because she eats them too quickly.

questions.prompt: How ______ coffee do you drink every day?
questions.explanation: coffee 是不可数名词，询问数量用 how much。
questions.evidence: she drinks too much coffee on late shifts.

questions.prompt: How ______ eggs do we need for the cake?
questions.explanation: eggs 是可数名词复数，询问数量用 how many。
questions.evidence: She should buy some eggs, tomatoes, and rice.

questions.prompt: We have ______ milk in the fridge. We can make breakfast.
questions.explanation: milk 是不可数名词，表示“一点牛奶”用 a little。
questions.evidence: She has a little milk in the fridge, so she can make a healthy breakfast.

questions.prompt: There are ______ people in the park today.
questions.explanation: people 是可数名词复数，表示“几个人”用 a few。
questions.evidence: She has a few apples, too.
